items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I worked with Henry Hardin... With the first trumpet player. Gilbert Young was the second trumpet player. Russell's third trumpet player.

ctx.x: Earl Bostick stayed around here a long time. Yeah. He was a great saxophone player. Mm-hmm. Gilbert Young was pretty nice during his days. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
